headline: New auth and merged users across servers
upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. Auth and user data migrate, and downgrading to 1.4.x afterward is not supported

highlights.title: Auth
highlights.body: Login is rebuilt: local username and password, Plex, and optional SSO through `OIDC_ISSUER_URL`, `OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, and `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET`. Web users log in once after upgrading; paired mobile devices stay paired. Behind a proxy that rewrites Host, forward X-Forwarded-Host or set `CORS_ORIGIN`.

highlights.title: Merge users across servers
highlights.body: Merge the same person's accounts across servers into one identity. Suggestions surface likely matches, and merges split back apart, even chained ones. Merged people count once on the Users page, leaderboards, and unique viewers, and rules can target a person on all their servers.

changes.text: the history page is much faster and its pagination edge cases are gone
resolution labels trust the server, and the jobs page can relabel old history
sessions no longer duplicate when SSE and reconciliation race
the poller no longer overloads under heavy concurrent streams
the mobile app recovers requests that stalled while it was in the background
login reconnects after a database restore
helm chart installs work again and the chart tracks the release version
Jellyfin credential login is gone; the docs site covers password reset
the app image runs Node 24 and the Redis image moved to v8
update the Jellyfin and Emby SSE plugin for this release's SSE improvements
